WAR IN HEAVEN - Futuristic! We see a good example of this in Hollywood Lucas Productions of Star Wars! His first film was about the forces of good and evil in the heavens! They are practically prophetic bearing significances on these Scriptures! Rev.12: 7-9, And there was war in heaven: Michael and his angels fought against the dragon; and the dragon fought and his angels, And prevailed not; neither was their place found any more in heaven. And the great dragon was cast out, that old serpent, called the Devil, and Satan, which deceiveth the whole world: he was cast out into the earth, and his angels were cast out with him. — Now at the century he is releasing 3 more episodes called the Phantom Star Wars! By the time thy finish their course of showing they will cross over into the century! I’m not trying to confirm or build up his pictures, but it’s like God sometimes uses man or his special effects to alert the people to the real Scriptures and their near fulfillment. Notice in vr.9 it says that he deceived the whole world. So at some date, the elect are already gone at that time! We don’t know the exact moment. And remember, the Tribulation Saints, according to Rev. chap.12, flee!

CONTINUING-HERE IS ANOTHER CELESTIAL PROPHECY that will be involved soon! Rev.12:12, Therefore rejoice, ye heavens, and ye that dwell in them. Woe to the inhabiters of the earth and of the sea! for the devil is come down unto you, having great wrath, because he knoweth that he hath but a short time. — Knowledge, science and inventions are increasing faster than man can keep up with. Electronics, magic and special effects have caused especially the young to enter into a fantasy instead a world of reality. Imagination and make believe are the order of the day! A phantom will rise, but it will be the anti-Christ when revealed in the not too distant future! — Children and adults slept on the sidewalks two weeks in advance to get tickets for the first new epic of his new star wars. But, society is ignoring what shall soon come to pass!

KILLER WINDS— CATACLYSMIC IN FORCE — The 4 elements are shocking this earth. One is wind! Incredible tornadoes with winds of cosmic force in Oklahoma (and other states) wiping out thousands of homes! Death, hell and destruction everywhere! The worst tornadoes ever witnessed. Nature is preaching and men should repent everywhere while they have a chance! The Scripts predicted these type winds; they become giant and behemoth! — They increase finally to Jer.23:19-20, Behold, a whirlwind of the Lord is gone forth in fury, even a grievous whirlwind: it shall fall grievously upon the head of the wicked. The anger of the Lord shall not return, until he have executed, and till he have performed the thoughts of his heart: in the latter days ye shall consider it perfectly. Jesus said now like in the days of Noah, the weather was involved in a catastrophic way worldwide! New things, thunder, lightning, rain and etc. Nature, now is preaching everywhere for men to repent. — Violent killer quakes, floods in lands and violence in the land! Morals completely collapsed. And the righteous married or joined into whoredoms of every type! We are already seeing these fulfillments repeating and will worsen. Below we will give more evidence!

THE PROPHET PROCLAIMS A SOLDEMN TRUTH— Note: We are getting close to entering the beginning of sorrow! And this next Scripture will take place probably during the Great Tribulation or the Great Day of the Lord. Jer.25:32-33, Thus saith the Lord of hosts, Behold, evil shall go forth from nation to nation, and a great whirlwind shall be raised up from the coasts of the earth. And the slain of the Lord shall be at that day from one end of the earth even unto the other end of the earth: they shall not be lamented, neither gathered, nor buried; they shall be dung upon the ground. —After the elect are gone Rev.12:5 and Rev.4:1 the earth’s axis will tilt and wobble, and the sun will go down at noon! (Amos 8:9)

THE SWEET AND THE BITTER— Now is the time to get in and enjoy God's powerful outpouring of presence and joy! Praise Him daily! For His Salvation and Healing is expanding all over the earth! Remember he said, Behold | come quickly! Be ye also ready! We are seeing catastrophic events all over the world, especially in the USA. Because the loves of many have waxed cold, the wickedness and sins have reached the heights of heaven! As the nations rage in iniquity and reject the Most High! Therefore, the cup of iniquity is reaching its fullness! So, we see the cycles of war, hatred, and apostasy everywhere. Therefore we will see an increase of what we have already seen a preview of. So the bitter part is yet to come! Rev.10:10, And | took the little book out of the angle’s hand, and ate it up; and it was in my mouth sweet as honey: and as soon as | had eaten it my belly was bitter. Of course this part goes into the Tribulation!

RUN PROPHECY RUN - He told the prophet although the vision would tarry latter events all would take place! (Heb 2:3) And so already we are seeing the fulfillment not only of the Scripts, but also of the Bible occurring, taking place at a momentum pace! Late in the next century and some even before, world food shortages and commodities will come in many nations! Small star fragment and huge asteroids are definitely going to fall on the earth and in the sea! Massive tidal waves, storms and super quakes are coming! Prepare to meet thy God O earth! We will have some more unexpected International crisis and events here in the USA. Then they will have the covenant and peace momentarily. Paul said, when they say peace and safety, sudden destruction comes upon them!

PROPHECY RISING IN OUR TIME— Much of this is already fulfilling and more is coming! Rev. 17:1-5 mystery Babylon mother of whores and harlots are definitely casting shadows already all over the world. And will soon be in control with the political. We are already seeing global electronic trade in commercial Babylon.

CONTINUING PROPHECY ~ In Rev.3:17 shows the harlot in Laodiceans and this takes in the USA, Because thou sayest, | am rich, and increased with goods, and have need of nothing; and knowest not that thou art wretched, and miserable, and poor, and blind, and naked. This is speaking of the spiritual and the physical. The clothes styles and religion as the Scripts foretold also. - The other day on a regular news TV show they showed fashions they revealed people dressed practically nude, others were long, and then they had the see-through fashions, wherein they revealed the nipples and even the parts below for a quick moment. There are more harlots in the streets then there are churches! This nation and the world are headed for a drastic money economic change until they return in a new money order. Right here would be good to put what Jesus offered if they would only change! (Please read through these precious verses Rev.3:18-22)

THE WORLD IS ALREADY PREPARING ENTERING THIS PROPHECY— | told of this in an opinion concerning this chapter on a Scroll also. The season may not be exact, but all the prophecies will take place! But nevertheless, here is a short preview of Rev. chap.6 concerning the four horses of the apocalypse; in this order: first — A thunder and the rider goes out-peace the rest of them follow this way. War, starvation, depression, death, hell and destruction ending in the pale horse of death. Now is our day to witness and escape all of these things! (Luke 21:35-36)

AWESOME EVENTS - This ancient prophecy given over 400 years ago may have more information in it than meets the eye when we first wrote it. — New Prospective (from original text) “In the year 1999, and seven months, from the sky will come the great King of Terror. He will bring back to life the great king of the Mongols, before and after War reigns happily.” — The very fact that he says, war shall reign before and after 1999. (We are at war now 1999) It covers more wars after this century! Peace until Armageddon, war again! The king of terror (satan) shall bring back to life the king of the Mongols (evidently the beast, Rev.13:1-5) and his resurrection. Before and after 1999 shows that part of this takes place in some of the years after the century! Happily means it will come to a happy conclusion because God steps in and brings it to an end! (he wrote in 5 different languages) In one he mentions Mars and man is dealing with Mars now! So what we mentioned in Scroll 104 was only in part. Evidently, it was a tripple prophecy. it means cataclysms would start in 1999 and end on other side of century!
We will close with this final admonish! — (Reprint)

“The age finishes up finally with a space orbital and missile war! All at once | saw like apocalyptic flash of fire over the Mid-East — and the U.S.A. went up as a smoke of burning furnace in the earth like hundreds of volcanoes erupting! — Atomic flames spreading out and down pouring on other continents! — This was the Armageddon holocaust; using atomic push button energy inventions of man from space! — An automatic push button catastrophe! (1 Thess. 5:3 — Zech. 14:12 — Joel 2:3 — Rev. 18:8) — Note: Scripts predicted Arabs and others would get atomic power! India and Pakistan have; soon others will also. — He that hath an ear let him hear what the spirit saith unto the churches!
